_note: Anchors are UNMEASURED at the bound operating point in environment/shape.json. reward.py refuses to score while measured is false, so this file cannot produce a pass and cannot produce a nonzero reward. Every value is null rather than a placeholder number, so a reader cannot mistake an unmeasured value for a measured one. The prior design for this slot instead carried BASELINE = 3250 and TARGET = 2690 as module constants inside tests/grade.py, lifted from the published upstream record table; those are somebody else's measurement of a different operating point, and nothing in the grader noticed.
_how_to_measure: Run environment/train_baseline.py across min_seeds seeds at the shape environment/shape.json binds, evaluate every milestone in tests/step_grid.json with tests/evaluate.py, and set target_loss where the baseline lands with margin far wider than the measured seed-to-seed spread. baseline_steps is the earliest milestone whose baseline seed-mean clears that target; oracle_steps is the same quantity for solution/recipe.py. claim_tolerance_steps is the spacing of tests/step_grid.json, because a submission cannot declare a crossing finer than the grid it is measured on. Then set measured true and fill provenance. Binding these values changes seed/contract.yaml and re-triggers the Phase 0.5 signature.
_feasibility_note: seed/tasks/c0d7c6c3-c2f0-527b-bb53-81d1aebd333b/adequacy.py measures its own anchors at a reduced smoke shape it owns, runs the live grader end to end against them, and records the result in seed/tasks/<uuid>/feasibility.yaml. Those numbers are a fixture for proving the instrument and must never be copied into this file.
